race.description: Blackpoly Pipelines Country Stampede Qualifier Hcp
race.comment: I'M ZAC (5) is bursting to win after two sound Open placings, the latest a Longreach third when beaten just under a length after beginning awkwardly and laying in. His record around 1000m is strong enough to make the shorter trip a positive and he can feature. COCHRANE (4) was only just denied at Ewan and has the most persuasive track-and-distance profile among the main hopes, though barrier 10 leaves him with more to overcome. CONTEMPORARY (1) was well held as favourite at Mt Isa, but his Mackay 3yo+ Class 6 win two back and proven 1000m record keep him in the mix for a placing. JIMMYINTHEJUNGLE (10) races well at this distance, winning the last time he attemoted it three back at Toowoomba.
